posts.name: NinjaMonkey
posts.cooked:
Powerhound_2000:

Next up Mini Pack 3 with the best hero Guise

To be honest, I know people love this character, but I just can't stand him. Maybe its because he's based off of Deadpool which, much like Bobba Fett, I find to be one of the most overrated characters ever created. Or maybe its because he breaks the fourth wall, which while cute and a little funny, just completely takes me out of any story I'm reading or watching when a character does that.

I can get behind the Omnitron IV environment though, and fingers crossed for the Prime Warden variants now that all the heroes on the team are going to be available.
